source_title: From wastewater to feed: Understanding per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances occurrence in wastewater-irrigated crops
source_locator: Table 2, orchard grass first cutting, Control (C), Replicates 1-3; first cutting harvested 2023-07-08.
dataset_license_note: This file contains only derived replicate sums of published Table 2 analyte values; it is not the full source dataset. Attribution is retained and non-commercial source terms must be respected.
material: Orchard grass (Dactylis glomerata), control treatment grown in control soil and watered with tap water in a greenhouse at Penn State University Park, Pennsylvania, USA.
derivation: Within each of three reported replicate columns, sum the detected concentrations across the 40 targeted PFAS analytes listed for the control first-cutting orchard-grass samples. Treat table ND as zero. The replicate sums are derived from the table, not reported as a separate statistic in the article. Their arithmetic mean is 2.491 ug/kg dry matter. For the GreenHub wet-feed profile only, multiply by the VARTA sample dry_matter_fraction (0.143) and 1e-9 kg/ug to obtain kg targeted PFAS per kg wet feed.
uncertainty_and_limitations: Three composite subsamples from one greenhouse treatment and one harvest are not three independent roadside field sites.
ND-as-zero yields a lower-bound sum; analytes below the reporting limit may be present.
Only 40 target analytes were assessed; the value is not a total of all PFAS, precursors, or persistent organic chemicals.
The source grass, geography, soil, and greenhouse conditions differ from Dutch roadside feedstock.
The VARTA dry-matter fraction is a GreenHub conversion basis, not the source-study grass moisture.
activation: Used as a GreenHub-specific class-C profile proxy for the PFAS-only PersistentOrganics pool; not a matched feed assay, compliance result, or transferable default for other projects.
